  "title": "Our understanding of the College's needs",
  "text": "The College requires proposals to be submitted via its procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC [REQ-0002]. The service must go live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment [REQ-0014]. Furthermore, the solution must maintain an audit record of every signature event [REQ-0003], support current desktop and mobile browsers [REQ-0004], send reminders to signers within 72 hours [REQ-0005], and store signed documents for ten years [REQ-0007]. Integration with the student records system via the existing REST API is required [REQ-0009], alongside 99.5% monthly availability excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance [REQ-0011]. The scope also includes providing templates for twelve forms [REQ-0006], migrating records by 2027-02-28 [REQ-0008], proposing an on-premises deployment option [REQ-0010], and responding to severity-one incidents within one hour [REQ-0012].",
